launcher.label: Feedback: report a bug or request a feature
launcher.hiddenToastBody: Report from the account menu, {palette}, or {report}. The Feedback tab can bring the button back.

vote.add: Vote for this — {count, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}} so far
vote.remove: Remove your vote — {count, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}}
vote.failed: Your vote didn't go through. Try again.

editor.highlightHint: Drag to draw a box round the problem.
editor.redactHint: Drag to black out anything private.

dialog.title: Send feedback
dialog.description: LaunchStack is in testing. Tell the team what broke or what you need — every report is read, and replies show up in Feedback › My reports.
dialog.bugTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Upload stops at 90% for large PDFs
dialog.ideaTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Export a chat as a Word document
dialog.charsLeft: {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} left
dialog.bugBodyPlaceholder: What did you do, what did you expect, and what happened instead?
dialog.ideaBodyPlaceholder: What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today?
dialog.severity: How much is it in your way?

errors.rateLimited: You've sent several reports in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.generic: Your report didn't send. Check your connection and try again.

editor.title: Mark up the screenshot
editor.description: Box what's wrong, or hide anything that shouldn't leave your screen. The team sees exactly this.

images.label: Screenshots
images.wrongType: Only PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF images can be attached.
images.tooBig: Each image can be up to {mb} MB.
images.captureFailed: Couldn't capture this page. Take a screenshot yourself and paste or attach it instead.

context.errorsCount: {count, plural, one {# recent error} other {# recent errors}}
context.alsoSent: Your name and email go with the report so the team can reply, along with the app's version and your current workspace. With technical details off, only the page is sent.

similar.title: Already requested — vote instead?
similar.hint: A vote on an existing request counts for more than a new one that says the same.

sent.titleIdea: Thanks — request #{id} is on the board
sent.body: The team will see it. When they reply or change its status, you'll get a note in the bell and can follow up in Feedback › My reports.

list.awaitingReply: Waiting for a reply from the team

mine.title: My reports
mine.sub: Bugs you reported and features you asked for, with the team's replies.
mine.emptyBody: Something broke, or something's missing? Use the Feedback button in the corner, or press {report} on any page.

ideas.title: Ideas
ideas.sub: What testers have asked for. Vote for the ones you want — the most-wanted rise to the top.
ideas.emptyBody: Be the first: tell the team what would make this more useful to you.

triage.title: Triage
triage.sub: Every report on this instance. Set a status and reply — the reporter sees both. A dot means the last word is theirs.
triage.emptyBody: When someone sends a bug report or a feature request, it lands here.

report.goneBody: It may have been removed, or it isn't one you can see.
report.threadEmpty: No replies yet. The team will answer here, and you'll get a note in the bell.
report.threadEmptyTriage: No replies yet. A reply here reaches the reporter in their bell.
report.replyPlaceholder: Add more detail, or answer the team's question…
report.replyHint: The team sees this straight away.
report.replyHintTeam: The reporter gets a note in their bell.
report.replyFailed: Your reply didn't send. Try again.
report.statusHint: A status change tells the reporter too.
report.issueCopied: Copied as a GitHub issue — without the reporter's name or screenshots
report.privateNote: Who asked, and the page they were on, stay between them and the team.
report.rateLimited: You've sent several replies in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.

tool.title: Feedback
tool.about: Report bugs and ask for features while the product is in testing, vote on what others asked for, and follow the team's replies.
tool.offBody: This instance hasn't named anyone to read reports, so there's nowhere for them to go. An operator turns it on by setting FEEDBACK_ADMIN_EMAILS.
tool.triageDeniedBody: Only the people who run this instance see every report. Yours are under My reports.

contact.title: Found a bug, or missing something?
contact.body: Report it in the app — with the page and a screenshot attached — and follow the team's reply under Feedback.
